## THE WORLD IN ONE BREATH

**Ecotopia** is the last sustainable utopia, and it is very, very cozy. It is run by **R.E.I.G.N.**, the *Regime for Ecological Integrity and Global Nurturing*: the guiding hand, "so that no citizen ever has to wonder what comes next."

<div class="propaganda" data-label="The voice of R.E.I.G.N.">

R.E.I.G.N. never threatens. It has simply already decided, for your own good. *"Questions are welcome. They have already been answered."*

</div>

* **The Guardian**: a great stag watches over Ecotopia. *"It sees everything, and it forgives most of it."*
* **AI is banned** by decree of R.E.I.G.N. (The citizen site insists it was made entirely by devoted human hands.)
* **The Governors** read every concern. Concerns are forwarded to the Ministry of Vigilance. *Please keep your evenings free.*
* **Carbon debt**: you were born owing the planet a little. Happily, R.E.I.G.N. accepts confessions.
* **Records**: every citizen record is released back to nature on 19 December. *Nothing outlives the celebration.*

[Read the full world →](lore.qmd){.cta-btn}

## THE NIGHT

* **Saturday 28 November, 21:00 to 04:00.** Arrive 20:30 to 21:00 for your **inburgering**.
* Every citizen is assigned **one ministry and one quest**.
* Until around midnight it is a game and a party at once: ministries, missions and a little intrigue. After that, it is just a party.
* One donation covers everything inside. *Places are given, not taken.*
* Not applied? You are processed at the door: a longer wait, and further obligations.
